'''Lom Pyke''' was a [[Pyke/Legends|Pyke]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal leader who merged his [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|family organization]] with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] sometime around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. He was also Prime Minister of Oba Diah.

==Biography==
[[File:PykeSyndicate-FFp78.png|thumb|left|250px|Lom Pyke led the Syndicate until his death at the hands of Count Dooku.]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] set up a secret negotiation between the Pyke Syndicate and the Republic concerning their monopoly of the spice trade, sending Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] as the ambassador, due to his experience with the underworld, along with his personal aide [[Silman/Legends|Silman]]. Lom Pyke was contacted by a man named [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]] who wished to have Sifo-Dyas killed, and they secretly negotiated a deal. Sifo-Dyas was called off [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]] by the Jedi Council to assist in a tribal dispute on Felucia. As he left the moon, Sifo-Dyas' ship was shot down by Pykes, who delivered Sifo-Dyas' body to Tyranus, but kept Silman, who they had found still alive in the wreckage.<ref name="TLO">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] Pyke approached [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]] at the new [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|camp]], and he stated that he knew that Maul was forming an army. He then said that he had no desire to oppose Maul in any way and that he wanted to join the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Eminence" />

Pyke and the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] forces were instrumental in the eventual [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], after he joined Maul's criminal organization. In Sundari, Pyke was a part of a small strike team that included [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and attacked and destroyed the [[Mandalore Banking Center/Legends|Mandalore Banking Center]]. Pyke's team was ultimately stopped by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] himself, and Pyke and Opress were presented to the people of Sundari as prisoners. However, Pyke managed to escape from custody and he returned to his home planet, Oba Diah.<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>

[[File:EpGuide610.png|thumb|right|250px|Lom escorts his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] "guests" to Silman.]]
Lom Pyke later received an unexpected visit from Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, who sought the truth about the death of Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas. Pyke agreed to help the Jedi only after they noticed him wearing the insignia of the former Chancellor, Finis Valorum; the criminal brought them to Silman, whom he had kept as a hostage as a bargaining chip. He gave the Jedi access to Silman in exchange for amnesty concerning their betrayal of the Jedi.<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>

To tie up loose ends regarding his role in the murder of Sifo-Dyas, [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku traveled to Oba Diah, where he killed Silman and dueled Anakin and Obi-Wan. The two Jedi were aided by the Pykes. Lom Pyke declared to Dooku that he had no more business with the Pykes, addressing him as "Tyranus," alerting the Jedi to Dooku's Sith name. In the ensuing fight, Obi-Wan and Anakin attempted to use a Force push against Dooku, but he dodged the attack and it ended up knocking Lom Pyke and his men over. The disarmed Pyke was swiftly killed by Dooku.<ref name="TLO" />
